identity.title: Route stable CSM commands through the active Runtime generation

values.task_boundary: Deliver only the installer-managed stable CSM command route and focused regression proof for issue #678.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The stable .adl/bin/csm runtime-v3 status --init <file> --json route executes the same generation-owned CSM artifact as .adl/runtime-v3/current/bin/csm.
AC-2: .adl/bin/csm cannot silently remain an independently built Runtime-control binary after an active generation is installed.
AC-3: Generation activation and rollback atomically switch the stable command route with the complete CSM, Guardian, and kernel generation.
AC-4: A missing, incomplete, or invalid active generation fails before any service mutation.
AC-5: A deterministic regression fixture reproduces a stale stable binary beside a valid current generation and proves the stable command follows current.
AC-6: Status-path validation does not restart, reload, or stop the live Runtime.
dependencies: Issue #656 / PR #658 atomic Runtime generation installation baseline.
Issue #659 convergence-policy work remains out of scope.
non_goals: Provider, model, agent, or Observatory behavior changes.
Live Runtime rollout, restart, reload, or stop.
Replacing atomic generation installation with a second binary source of truth.
